INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792x1024 or preferably 1920x1080 pixels (width over 1000). The source article is a team analysis about Osaka Evessa's last five games. All visible sporting text is TEAM-level, never the illustrated player's own record.

Art direction: approved バスケまとめ editorial style: deep charcoal #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, warm off-white typography, black/ivory hand-drawn ink and brush illustration with visible hatching. Minimal elements, powerful legible bold Japanese headlines, no photorealism. Refer to the black/lime style image seen in context for its aesthetic ONLY, do not reproduce its player, 38 score, date, or content.

Main visual subject: the real basketball player DAMONTE DODD (ダモンテ・ドッド), selected randomly from named players in the fixed article, drawn as an unmistakable hand-rendered illustration. Match the officially viewed Osaka Evessa portrait's appearance: broad athletic muscular build, medium-dark brown skin translated to warm gray ink tones, broad oval face, high forehead, dense natural black afro rising and spreading to both sides with shorter tapered temples, thick complete black beard outlining cheeks and chin, connected mustache, broad nose with round tip, full lips, dark almond eyes. Distinctive face must be visible, three-quarter view with a focused neutral athletic expression, not an invented generic athlete. Head not looking away. No thin face, no short buzz cut, no pale face.
Pose: dynamic pivot with bent knees and torso twisting toward the viewer; both hands securely gripping an orange basketball at upper waist/chest level, protecting it while preparing a move. Show head through upper thighs, strong diagonal movement, face and both hands fully inside frame. Position the player in the right 43% of frame. Anatomically credible arms, two hands, five natural fingers each including sensible hidden fingers; ball entirely inside canvas. No opponent needed. Plain unbranded dark basketball jersey and shorts with narrow ivory piping, NO jersey number, NO name, NO lettering, NO logos, NO sponsor graphics. An original generic basketball action illustration, NOT a recreation of an actual game, NOT evidence of his playing in these five games. The article says he did NOT play in the five games; do not depict a real match, named opponent, scoreboard, or victory celebration.

Typography and exact visible text: Place the following wording only, with generous safe margins at least 60 pixels on every side. All exact Japanese text must be clean and readable.
Small top left: "バスケまとめ"
Small near it: "2026.11.10"
Large left upper headline: "大阪エヴェッサ"
Medium scope line immediately above record: "直近5試合"
Largest left-center display: "0勝5敗" (lime 0 and 5, off-white 勝 and 敗; balanced as one clear record)
Small clear period below: "10/23〜11/7"
At bottom left, readable in off-white, not touching border: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Alongside this label: "イメージ"

Keep all these text elements away from the face, hands, and ball. No player's name anywhere on the image. No player individual statistics, claim of participation or achievement, no unrelated claims, no copied official photograph. No team or league logo, no watermark, no decorative text. Athletic image is a generic illustrative image only. Overall polished editorial composition with expressive lime diagonal/curved brushwork behind player and ample quiet black around the large headline.


ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION
Edit the first image (the generated black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail) once to correct ONLY the illustrated real player Damonte Dodd's likeness and head framing. The second image is his official Osaka Evessa profile portrait, used for facial appearance reference only. DO NOT paste or reproduce that photograph; DO NOT transfer its logos, jersey number, sponsors, uniform lettering, or photo style.
Keep the entire thumbnail's text verbatim, typography, 0勝5敗, 直近5試合, 10/23〜11/7, date, bottom AI and イメージ labels, colors, background, ball, hands, torso pivot pose, jersey and shorts exactly as in image 1.
Fix the head: the first illustration's afro is much too large and cut off by the top edge. Reduce its hair silhouette volume by about 40 percent to match the tighter natural afro in official portrait 2, keep shorter tapered temples and high visible forehead, leave AT LEAST 35 pixels of visible black background above the complete hair. Retain broad oval face, thick but neatly shaped full beard and connected mustache. Match portrait 2's softer broad cheeks, eyes, broad nose and full lips, removing exaggerated forehead furrows and excessive aging. Keep a focused athletic neutral expression. Preserve the same strong ink/brush illustration rendering with hatching and hand-drawn contours, never photorealistic.
Both hands, basketball and face remain fully inside frame; no new text, logos or additional people. Landscape dimensions and all other components unchanged.
